self.disposition: 7-point checklist inline. Spec compliance: all three decided changes present (decouple, escalate, floor) plus the operator-ruled AC10 narrowing. Error handling: the floor runs after the pending check so the more specific failure wins; unknown complexity skips, pinned by test. Security: no new inputs. Test quality: the floor is measured against the real 27-record corpus, not asserted. YAGNI: no bypass flag added. Boundaries: gate verdict + the runtime prompt changed together, since either alone leaves the contradiction.
